first_meet_generic: Yeah, yeah. You're weird. Join the club.
I've seen stranger. Not much stranger, but stranger.
Sova. I shoot things. Usually arrows, sometimes my mouth.
You going to be a problem? No? Good.
barrelman: Gnew-proof? Is that a selling point? Really?
Can you store arrows? No? Then I'm good.
snakecharmer: That snake's looking at me. I don't like it.
Mr. Whiskers? Seriously? For a cobra?
Keep that thing away from me. Far away.
You play a flute. Snake dances. World gets weirder.
lucha: I don't wrestle. I shoot from range. Smarter.
The cape would get in my way. No thanks.
You do you. Just don't do it near me.
ironchef: Cooking in armor. Seems hot. And stupid.
Can you make trail rations? No? Useless.
All that shouting. The food better be worth it.
trenchcoat: Mysterious. Great. Just what I need.
You following us? No? Sure looks like it.
Fourteen pockets. Probably full of knives. Or regrets.
Less mystery, more honesty. Try it sometime.
sumo: Big. Very big. Not moving. Good.
I won't challenge you. I'm not an idiot.
Stillness is fine. Until you need to run.
You'd make a great obstacle. Or wall.
foodboys: Food. Actual food. Finally something useful.
Which one? Don't care. Just feed me.
Every town? How do you beat us here?
Chili or salad? Both. I'm hungry.
coolcat: Jazz. Great. Can you play something useful?
Cool cat? More like cold shoulder.
pigman: The inn. Good. I need sleep. Real sleep.
Pork? Bacon? Don't care. Just hot food.
Smells okay. That's high praise from me.
Room with a window. For watching exits.
tunneler: Your back is wrecked. I can see it.
Found anything sharp down there? Arrowheads?
Retirement on a boat? Good luck with that.
bush: That's a bush. Why are we talking to a bush?
Wait. Did it just...? No. Couldn't be.
aeronaut: Balloons. Floating in the sky. Target practice?
How do you aim? You don't? Great.
One good arrow and you're grounded. Just saying.
I'll keep my feet on the ground. Literally.
onionboss: Union? Ever heard of it? Should look it up.
Do you actually do any work? Or just yell?
astronaut: Underwater. In a metal can. Hard pass.
That suit looks heavy. And claustrophobic.
What's down there? Monsters? Treasure? Both?
Rather fight on land. Where I can breathe.
conductor: A train. In the sky. Sure. Why not.
All aboard? Seriously? Who says that?
Where does it go? Don't care. As long as it's away.
On time? I'll believe it when I see it.
shoewoman: Shoes. Good. Mine are falling apart.
Desert-ready? Quiet? I need quiet shoes.
Can I run in them? Fight in them? Good.
Give me two pairs. No, three. Backup.
signguy: Your work is... everywhere. Hard to miss.
Ever make a sign pointing to treasure? No? Pity.
Hand-painted. Slow. But I guess accurate.
cobra: Snake. Big snake. Backing away slowly.
Nice snake. Good snake. Don't look at me.
Archery doesn't work well on snakes. Too low.
barrelgob: Living in a barrel. Seen worse.
Is it comfortable? Doesn't look comfortable.
You found a system. Can't argue with results.
Need a bigger barrel? No? Suit yourself.
twins: Two of you. Same face. Creepy.
Which one is which? Don't care. Moving on.
Do you ever separate? No? Figures.
sunandmoon: Fortune teller. Great. Waste of time.
Predict my future? Don't bother. I make my own.
That headdress must be a pain in the neck.
Stars don't care about us. Get over yourself.
